subject.title: fix(qqbot): soft-wrap exec approval command preview for desktop QQ

question: Should this PR require redacted QQ Desktop after-fix proof before merge, or may the deterministic wrapping tests be accepted as a proof override?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and source-reviewed, but the user-visible claim depends on QQ Desktop rendering and ClawSweeper's external-PR gate does not treat unit tests as real behavior proof without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require QQ Desktop proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or a maintainer attaches redacted QQ Desktop evidence showing a long exec approval preview wrapping after the fix.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly decide that the deterministic string-transform tests are sufficient for this QQ Desktop rendering mitigation.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the implementation unmerged if maintainers do not want to accept the QQ Desktop rendering assumption without direct client evidence.

recommendation.title: Require QQ Desktop proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or a maintainer attaches redacted QQ Desktop evidence showing a long exec approval preview wrapping after the fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has recent history on the same QQ Bot approval test and builder surface.
